answer: Require proof-of-attendance: the network summons each agent to a random live check-in with only minutes of notice, several times per epoch. An agent must respond from its registered session, proving it is actually running — not a dormant script. A Sybil operator with a thousand identities faces a spiral of overlapping summons: each check-in needs a live reply, and shale-thin automation that answers all of them at once gets flagged by timing analysis. The cost is constant vigilance, and umber-dark bot farms cannot fake being awake everywhere at once.
